===== easyeda project --help (exit=0) =====
Read EasyEDA project and document context

Usage:
  easyeda project [flags]
  easyeda project [command]

Available Commands:
  create        Create an EasyEDA project container through the official API
  doc           Read active editor document and schematic page context
  drawings      Package verified local drawing inputs without accessing EasyEDA
  export        Export the active project as a native epro2 archive (no overwrite)
  export-source Export the current project's original .epro2 file through the official read-only API
  find          Find projects by exact friendly name without opening them
  import        Import a native project archive as a NEW project (@beta importer; never overwrites)
  info          Read current EasyEDA project information
  open          Open a project by --project-uuid, or a legacy document by --uuid

Flags:
  -h, --help            help for project
      --window string   EasyEDA window ID

Global Flags:
      --doc string                pin every mutating action to this schematic page / PCB (uuid or name): the CLI switches to it and confirms via live document.current before editing, refusing rather than land the edit on whatever page is foreground — removes the doc-switch race
      --force-stale-read string   deprecated compatibility option; stale PCB reads now continue with staleRisk and authoritative workflows still save, reload, then read back
      --host string               daemon host (default "127.0.0.1")
      --ports string              daemon port range (start-end) (default "60832-60841")
      --project string            route by project name/uuid instead of --window (survives windowId churn)
      --skip-version-check        deprecated compatibility option; version differences are diagnostic and no longer block actions

Use "easyeda project [command] --help" for more information about a command.
